legend: The annual college sports-ball tournament is approaching, which for trademark reasons we'll refer to as Third Month Insanity. There are a total of 2N teams participating in the tournament, numbered from 1 to 2N. The tournament lasts N rounds, with each round eliminating half the teams. The first round consists of 2N - 1 games, numbered starting from 1. In game i, team 2·i - 1 will play against team 2·i. The loser is eliminated and the winner advances to the next round (there are no ties). Each subsequent round has half as many games as the previous round, and in game i the winner of the previous round's game 2·i - 1 will play against the winner of the previous round's game 2·i.

Every year the office has a pool to see who can create the best bracket. A bracket is a set of winner predictions for every game. For games in the first round you may predict either team to win, but for games in later rounds the winner you predict must also be predicted as a winner in the previous round. Note that the bracket is fully constructed before any games are actually played. Correct predictions in the first round are worth 1 point, and correct predictions in each subsequent round are worth twice as many points as the previous, so correct predictions in the final game are worth 2N - 1 points.

For every pair of teams in the league, you have estimated the probability of each team winning if they play against each other. Now you want to construct a bracket with the maximum possible expected score.
input: Input will begin with a line containing N (2 ≤ N ≤ 6).

2N lines follow, each with 2N integers. The j-th column of the i-th row indicates the percentage chance that team i will defeat team j, unless i = j, in which case the value will be 0. It is guaranteed that the i-th column of the j-th row plus the j-th column of the i-th row will add to exactly 100.
output: Print the maximum possible expected score over all possible brackets. Your answer must be correct to within an absolute or relative error of 10 - 9.
Formally, let your answer be a, and the jury's answer be b. Your answer will be considered correct, if ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d9eaa1eb5c0113a563036232d18ed097f799eecd.png).
note: In the first example, you should predict teams 1 and 4 to win in round 1, and team 1 to win in round 2. Recall that the winner you predict in round 2 must also be predicted as a winner in round 1.

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，你应预测第 1 阶段由队伍 1 和 4 获胜，并预测第 2 阶段由队伍 1 获胜。请注意，你在第 2 阶段预测的获胜队伍也必须在第 1 阶段被预测为获胜队伍。

legend.ai: 一年一度的大学体育球类锦标赛即将开始，出于商标方面的原因，我们将其称为“第三月疯狂”。共有 2N 支队伍参加比赛，编号从 1 到 2N。比赛共进行 N 轮，每轮淘汰一半的队伍。第一轮包含 2N - 1 场比赛，比赛编号从 1 开始。在第 i 场比赛中，队伍 2·i - 1 将与队伍 2·i 进行比赛。负者被淘汰，胜者晋级下一轮（比赛不存在平局）。之后的每一轮比赛场数都是上一轮的一半，并且在第 i 场比赛中，上一轮第 2·i - 1 场比赛的胜者将与上一轮第 2·i 场比赛的胜者进行比赛。
每年办公室都会组织一场竞猜，看看谁能制定出最佳的晋级表。晋级表是对每场比赛获胜队伍的一组预测。对于第一轮的比赛，你可以预测任意一支队伍获胜；但对于之后各轮的比赛，你预测的获胜队伍还必须在上一轮中被预测为获胜者。注意，在实际进行任何比赛之前，晋级表就已经完全制定好了。第一轮中预测正确可得 1 分，之后每轮中预测正确所得分数都是前一轮的两倍，因此在最终比赛中预测正确可得 2^(N-1) 分。
对于联赛中的每一对队伍，你都估计了它们相互比赛时各自获胜的概率。现在你想构造一个使期望得分尽可能大的晋级表。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含 N（2 ≤ N ≤ 6）。
接下来有 2^N 行，每行包含 2^N 个整数。第 i 行第 j 列表示队伍 i 击败队伍 j 的概率百分比；当 i = j 时，该值为 0。保证第 j 行第 i 列与第 i 行第 j 列之和恰好为 100。

output.ai: 输出所有可能晋级表中的最大期望得分。你的答案必须满足绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10^(-9)。
形式化地，设你的答案为 a，评测答案为 b。如果 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d9eaa1eb5c0113a563036232d18ed097f799eecd.png)，则认为你的答案正确。
